name: Live Region
summary: A live region is an element a screen reader watches, so text written into it is read out. Use it to announce something that happens without moving focus, like a save confirmation or a result count. The region has to be on the page and empty before the message arrives, or nothing is announced.
demoNote: Turn on a screen reader before pressing anything — nothing on this page can be judged by looking at it. The regions are drawn as visible boxes so you can watch text land in them; in an app they would be clipped.

contract.useWhen: Announcing a change without moving focus, in a region that was already there.
keyboard: native: reaches the role=log scroller, which is a tab stop only because it scrolls
failureModes: the region injected already holding its text, so nothing changed after it was observed
display:none on the region, which is not in the tree to change
cleared and set in the same tick, which is reported as one state
one requestAnimationFrame — it runs before paint, so both writes still batch
aria-live written by hand instead of the role, losing aria-atomic and the name
assertive for anything merely important, rather than for what stops being useful in seconds
